sources.source_name: PM Gati Shakti: Aviation and Railway Ministries join forces to expedite rail access for three upcoming airports
sources.notes: Dated October 2023 (day not captured); cites a Business Standard report. Civil Aviation Minister wrote to the Railways Minister on 8 May and the ministries agreed on 10 July to coordinate rail links to Noida, Navi Mumbai and Dholera airports, identified as high-impact projects under the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan. Timelines in the article are out of date; no current rail-link status is claimed here.

sources.source_name: Vizhinjam port rail link to be completed
sources.notes: Undated in the capture. Reports the Railway Minister saying the 10.7 km Vizhinjam port–Balaramapuram line was included in the PM Gati Shakti master plan, after which Railways took over its construction and maintenance. Single press report; completion status and dates not verified.

sources.source_name: Revised Final Sagarmala Vision (JNPA slide deck): "String of Ports in India"
sources.notes: Undated slide deck. Slide 2 ("String of Ports in India", marked NOT TO SCALE) names major and minor ports along the coast. Used only for the names of ports not already in the Atlas registry; positions on the Techadyant map are town-level, set by Techadyant. No throughput or status is taken from the slide.
